title: UAPI stability: crypto2dev_status has no reserved bytes
description: struct crypto2dev_status (ioctl slot 9, CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_STATUS) has zero reserved bytes: fips_state(u32) + num_algorithms(u32) + version[32] = 40 bytes total, no _pad. Because _IOR encodes sizeof(struct) into the ioctl command number, any future field addition changes the ioctl number, breaking ABI compatibility with existing userspace. The struct is a natural candidate for future extension (e.g. num_providers, fips_algorithm_count, build_version). Add __u8 _reserved[24] (or similar) at the end of the struct and validate in ioctl_status that all reserved bytes are zero on the input struct before writing the output — this reserves room for future fields within the current struct size without an ABI break. All other extensible structs already have _pad fields; status is the only output-only introspection struct that has none.
